scope: Actual native account owner, MainData client/queue, production Coordinator and attachment binding with controlled Electron process/port/dialog carriers and real temporary-file I/O. Fixed capture guards admission, queued posting, reply acceptance and native continuations; ordinary account cleanup remains possible. Existing shipping esbuild bundles are compiled, not a full TypeScript strict typecheck. Real Electron/account/provider/device/platform, sand-media streaming, composer target admission and complete Rust migration acceptance remain open.
